outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal birth vs. Cesarean section)
cohort: 1209 pregnant women at three tertiary hospitals in Shanghai, China
finding: The study found that epidural analgesia, primiparity, continuous electronic fetal monitoring, and increased birth weight were independently associated with longer duration of labor.
mod_finding: The median duration of total stage of labor was significantly longer in the nulliparous group than in the multiparous group.
birth_weight: Increased birth weight was associated with longer labor duration.
